Frequently Asked Questions

Can RethinkBH help new ABA practices get started?

Yes. RethinkBH offers start-up ABA solutions with all the essential clinical, billing, and scheduling tools, plus access to a support community and expert resources.

Is RethinkBH designed for both small and large ABA practices?

Yes. RethinkBH is built to scale with practices of all sizes, from solo providers to large multi-site organizations. The platform supports scheduling, data collection, billing, and reporting, with flexible features that adapt to the unique needs of growing practices.
